items.title: Bob Wilber Interview, 1961-05-01
items.q: And I loved playing with him, and he, the way he could make a press roll swing on the drums was just terrific. Yeah. Yeah. That rhythm section was, with, with Sam Price, Pop Foster, and Baby Dogs.
